rawContent: @TheMendozaWoman When the Met were encouraging #BLM protesters to go home and get their  "voices heard in other ways." I asked them for suggestions of how that might be done. Answer came there none ..........

@WillBlackWriter @pfoa_uk So it turns out that 1 of the 6 photos is a cop who may have been harmed by someone at the #BLM demo in Whitehall on June 7th. 3 are from other demos & the other 2 are different shots of the officer who hit a lamp post during a horse charge on the crowd - https://t.co/4QXbNCoMat

@BBCNews saying we shouldn't call the far right 'counter protesters' cos they are there for a variety of reasons, some because they say #AllLivesMatter - which is actually countering #BlackLivesMatter .......... no?
